Append a Chromatogram to Another Run

Source: R/append.R
chrom_append_run.Rd

Joins runs end to end: the time and volume of each run continue from the end of the run before it. Optionally continues the numbering of the fractions after the previous runs.

Usage

chrom_append_run(.data, ..., adjust_fractions = FALSE)

Arguments

.data

A data frame created through chrom_read_*()

...

Runs created through chrom_read_*()

adjust_fractions

Logical. FALSE keeps the fraction numbering as-is. TRUE renumbers the fractions of a run that starts again from a fraction number already used, so they continue after the fractions of the runs before it. Runs whose fractions already continue the numbering are left as they are.

Value

a tibble which combines the given runs, with a run column giving the number of the run each row comes from. If all the runs are chromatograms, it is a chromatogram whose metadata has the run, date, method and file of each run; see chrom_meta().

Examples


fl1 <- system.file("extdata",
  "example_quadtec_1.TXT",
  package = "chromr"
)
fl2 <- system.file("extdata",
  "example_quadtec_2.TXT",
  package = "chromr"
)
df1 <- chrom_read_quadtech(fl1)
df2 <- chrom_read_quadtech(fl2)


df1 |>
  chrom_append_run(df2)
